name: Marcoryl
backstory:
__notoc__
Marcoryl is a druid of the Emerald Grove in Act One. He dislikes visitors and is very concerned for the Grove's safety.
voice_hint: half-elf druid (novice} (voiced by Adam Rhys Dee)
